title.zh: Polymarket Fires CMO Matthew Modabber Amid Fake Promotion Claims and CFTC Probe
title.en: Polymarket Fires CMO Matthew Modabber Amid Fake Promotion Claims and CFTC Probe

current_state.zh: Polymarket dismissed CMO Matthew Modabber after an internal investigation into allegedly fake trading-profit promotional content and influencer payments made via personal accounts, with the matter now under an ongoing CFTC investigation.
